reason: I already reorder my own thing when it runs out and my drawer is full of half-used bottles. I'm not adding another one for a single form of magnesium.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products have several forms in one capsule? And it's made in China, which makes me want to see that lab report before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: A reason this one form works better than the multi-form blends I already see, plus a free or very cheap trial box so I don't end up with another half-used bottle.
